meta.title: Bidding is refused once the RFQ's auction exists
warnings: a read-back was added in code: As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that the round counts no new bid (nothing was created).

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer converts the RFQ pricing round into an auction.
The invited vendor tries to open a bid on the original RFQ after its auction exists.
As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that the round counts no new bid (nothing was created).
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “You cannot edit rfq once the auction is created.”, and never with a server error. Read back afterwards: the round counts no new bid (nothing was created).
